summary: - **[key4hep/k4FWCore#447](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/447)** — OverlayTiming now adds the energy of background SimCalorimeterHit contributions to the existing hit they merge into; previously the merged hit's energy was not updated. **This changes overlay output:** a hit (signal or background) is now kept whole, with all contributions and full energy, if any one contribution falls inside the time window. Per-contribution time cuts are left to digitization, and the PR raises the minimum required EDM4hep and podio versions.

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#171](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/171)** — Fixes the RecoMCLink collection in the Gaudi k4SimDelphesAlg workflow, which was always empty. The links are now created while the reco-to-gen mapping is still available, so Gaudi-based Delphes output links reconstructed particles back to the input MCParticles.

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#172](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/172)** — Converts EDM4hep MCParticle production times from ns to the mm/c units Delphes expects when running through k4SimDelphesAlg. Previously, re-exported particle times, track times at the vertex and calorimeter timing for displaced particles were wrong by a factor of c compared to the standalone executables.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#452](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/452)** — Fixes a memory leak in the Writer for collections registered through the legacy DataHandle or a DataWrapper, as k4SimDelphesAlg does. The leak was about 1.8 kB per event in a Pythia8 + k4SimDelphesAlg IDEA job, or about 1.7 GB over a long production run.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#676](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/676)** — ALLEGRO turbine ECAL endcap now places each wheel's cells in a dedicated mother volume. This cuts ddsim time-to-first-event from about 175 s to 104 s single-threaded (about 120 s to 40 s with 8 threads) and peak RSS by about 2 GB. Per-event time is unchanged within errors for 10k-event jobs, and a reconstruction-level cluster bug found during review was fixed before merge.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#682](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/682)** — Fixes the IDEA o2 dual-readout HCAL endcap cell ID metadata, which was encoded with the barrel encoding in the sensitive detector action.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#119](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/119)** — GGTFTrackFinder gets a major CPU-time and memory optimization. The LibTorch dependency is replaced by plain C++ clustering, ONNX Runtime graph optimizations are enabled, and a new InferenceThreads property controls intra-op threading (default 1).

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#417](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/417)** — Sets RandomSeed to 0 in the IDEA and CLD Delphes cards so ROOT picks a new seed for each run. Previously the fixed upstream seed gave every production job the same detector-smearing random sequence.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#414](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/414)** — Syncs the IDEA Delphes card with upstream Delphes, adding photon angular smearing and pointing in the dual-readout calorimeter. The EDM4hep output card now writes JetDurhamN2 and GenMissingET and drops ScalarHT. The new photon smearing requires Delphes ≥ 3.5.2pre02.

- **[AIDASoft/podio#1080](https://github.com/AIDASoft/podio/pull/1080)** — Generated EDM code now carries doxygen directives that hide podio-internal classes by default, using a PODIO_INTERNAL conditional section and a datamodel internals group. Downstream projects that build doxygen documentation from podio-generated EDMs must opt in to see these classes.
